data.title: 隐德来希 · 杯沿后的问题
data.description: 她放下咖啡杯，托腮看你，慢悠悠问：“既然一直记得，为什么现在才告诉我？”
data.action: 放下杯子托腮，目光直视镜头
data.camera: 近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: At a small secluded corner table in a vintage Parisian-style bistro, Entelechia rests her chin lightly on her palm, gazing straight into the viewer's eyes with an enigmatic, knowing smile. A delicate porcelain cup of dark roast espresso and an empty sugar wrapper sit on the marble tabletop, while warm amber wall sconces and rain-streaked window reflections heighten the intimate, confidential atmosphere.
